theater: 河南道京西北路順昌縣城

battle.name: 順昌之戰
battle.theater: 河南道京西北路順昌縣城
battle.brief: 紹興十年正月，金國貝勒完顏宗弼率十餘萬眾南侵，圍攻京西北路順昌縣。岳飛以精騎八千自鄂州兼程疾馳，一日百餘里抵城下，據城以逸待勞，夜襲金營、改其水道、破鹿角寨，擊潰元朮大軍，追至郾城再破拐子馬。火攻在此役僅屬輔助，希臘火一類燃燒兵器並無使用紀錄。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 交戰的兩方是金國與南宋。金方由女真完顏氏統治，金熙宗完顏亶坐鎮中都，把主力交給皇弟貝勒完顏宗弼，即兀朮。兀朮部自河南、汴京一線南下，兵力記載為十餘萬，其中直抵順昌城下的精騎逾萬。指揮系統以樞密院擬軍令、貝勒與萬戶分領兵權，攻城另設專司，配備撞竿、雲梯與窰車，糧秣車馬隨大軍同行，營寨之間以皮索、壕溝與鹿角相連。宋方朝廷由高宗趙構在位，中樞以秦檜為首的主和派當權，邊軍則以岳飛所領岳家軍為主力；岳飛時任湖北京西宣撫使，節制的部隊由吳玠、張所舊部與收編的楚軍混編而成，號令嚴整，凍死不拆屋、餓死不擄掠。順昌本為京西北路汝州屬縣，由劉錫率民兵與少量禁軍據城死守；淮上另有張俊、劉光世、韓世忠各擁重兵，按兵觀望，無一先至。糧秣由襄陽沿汝水轉運，水陸並行，步騎分屯。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Jin state and the Southern Song. The Jin side was ruled by the Jurchen Wanyan clan, with the Jin emperor Xizong, Wanyan Dan, seated at Zhongdu, while the bulk of the field army was handed to his half-brother the prince Wanyan Zongbi, better known as Wuzhu. Wuzhu's host moved south from the Henan and Bianjing lines with a recorded strength of more than a hundred thousand men, among them upwards of ten thousand elite cavalry riding right up to the walls of Shunchang. Command ran through the Privy Council, which drafted the orders, while princes and commanders of ten thousand held their own detachments; siege works had their own directorate, and battering poles, scaling ladders and stone-throwing engines travelled with the army, the camps linked to one another by rope barriers, ditches and spiked stockades. On the Song side Emperor Gaozong Zhao Gou sat on the throne and the central government was dominated by the peace party led by Qin Hui, while the frontier was carried by Yue Fei's army, of which Yue Fei was then the Huguang and Jingxi pacification commissioner. That force combined the old troops of Wu Jie and Zhang Suo with surrendered Chu rebels under strict discipline, freezing to death rather than tearing down roofs and starving rather than taking by force. Shunchang, a county of Ruzhou in the Jingxi circuit, was held by Liu Xi with militia and a thin garrison of imperial troops. Zhang Jun, Liu Guangshi and Han Shizhong commanded armies in the Huai region, but none advanced to help. Supplies came up the Ru River from Xiangyang, water and land in company, with infantry and cavalry posted separately.
people: 順昌之戰的關鍵人物是岳飛。岳飛字鵬舉，河南湯陰人，時任湖北京西宣撫使。得知順昌被圍，他不待全軍集齊，先以精騎八千自鄂州兼程疾馳，一日行百餘里，抵城下後整頓殘破城防，改易守具，分番出戰，又以疑兵虛張旗幟，使兀朮不敢輕進。完顏宗弼即兀朮，金太宗之子、與粘罕齊名的猛將，屢次南下破宋，這次統十餘萬眾攻順昌，敗後僅以數千騎遁走，幾為宋軍所擒。守臣劉錫在援軍未至之前死守城垣，為岳飛到場爭得時間。部將牛皋率鄉兵與民兵助戰，攻破城南鹿角寨；張喜、董威夜入金營直趨牙帳；楊政等破營奪馬並改其水道，令金軍不能取水；岳雲隨父出陣，於郾城破拐子馬。張俊、劉光世按兵不援，暴露南宋諸軍互不策應的弊病；秦檜則在建和與收兵之間主導朝局，順昌的勝利反為其後壓制岳飛埋下伏線。
peopleEn: The decisive figure was Yue Fei. A native of Tangyin in Henan, known by the courtesy name Pengju, he was then pacification commissioner for Huguang and Jingxi. On learning that Shunchang was invested he did not wait for the whole army to assemble: he took eight thousand picked cavalry out of Ezhou and marched them at forced pace, covering more than a hundred li a day. At the walls he rebuilt the battered defences, changed the stores of ammunition, rotated the troops in and out of the fighting line, and raised false banners so that Wuzhu would believe the main body had already arrived and hesitate to attack. Wuzhu himself, Wanyan Zongbi, was a son of Jin Taizong and a famous commander in the same rank as Nahan; he had campaigned into Song territory repeatedly and had destroyed Song armies in the past. At Shunchang he brought more than a hundred thousand men and after the defeat escaped with a few thousand riders, narrowly missing capture. Liu Xi, the commandant of the city, held the walls until relief came and bought the time Yue Fei needed. Among the commanders, Niu Gao brought up local militia and villagers to help the assault and carried the stockade on the south side of the city; Zhang Xi and Dong Wei rode into the Jin camp by night and struck at the tent of the commander-in-chief; Yang Zheng and others broke the camp, seized horses and turned the watercourse so the Jin army could not draw water; Yue Yun fought alongside his father and broke the tied armour cavalry at Yancheng. Zhang Jun and Liu Guangshi sat on their arms instead of moving, exposing how little the Song armies supported one another. Qin Hui steered the court between war and peace, and the victory at Shunchang, far from settling matters, laid the groundwork for his later destruction of Yue Fei.
kits: 這張卡上的兵器是希臘火，屬拜占庭即東羅馬帝國自七世紀起掌握的銅管噴射燃燒劑，配方是帝國機密，裝在銅管與泵裝置上，多配於戰船艦首，也能架在城頭或陣地直射，燃料在銅管內被點燃後噴出膏體，遇風自燃並黏附於水面或船板，難以撲滅。技術譜系上與之相應的中國記載見於《武經總要》所錄猛火油，以油膏灌入銅管，附猛火油櫃、火油櫃諸器，供守城時焚燒來犯者的攻城器械與城樓。順昌之戰沒有使用拜占庭配方的紀錄，攻寨的火只是火炬、薪柴與引火之物，屬輔助手段，決定勝負的仍是神臂弓、硬弓的穿甲火力與夜襲機動。實際投入的裝備方面，岳家軍有神臂弓、麻扎刀、朴刀、長槍與大盾，鎧甲以皮甲為主，馬匹充足並備隨軍糧秣與輜重車；金軍有拐子馬，即人馬皆披重甲、三騎為一聯、以皮索相連的重甲騎兵，另有女真騎射用強弓、拒馬、撞竿、雲梯與窰車等攻城器械，拐子馬後來在郾城被步卒砍腿破之。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is Greek fire, a burning mixture forced through copper pipes that the Byzantine, or Eastern Roman, Empire had held as a state secret since the seventh century. It was carried in copper tubes with pumping gear, mounted on the bows of warships but also set on towers and in the field; the charge was ignited inside the tube and spat out as a thick liquid that caught fire on contact with air, clung to water and to ship planking, and was extremely hard to extinguish. The Chinese counterpart in the same technical family is recorded in the Wujing Zongyao, the Military Canon of 1044, under the name menghuoyou, fierce-fire oil: grease poured into copper tubes and used with cabinets of fierce-fire oil and of fire oil, so that a defending garrison could burn enemy siege engines and towers. No record from the Shunchang campaign shows the Byzantine formula in use; the fire there was torches, firewood and faggots used in the assault on the camps, an auxiliary measure at best. What decided the battle was the penetrating power of the divine-arm bow and the stiff bow, and the mobility of the night attack. Among the equipment actually committed, the Yue Fei army carried divine-arm bows, mazha sabres, pu sabres, long spears and large shields, with leather armour for the most part, plenty of horses and baggage carts for grain. The Jin had the guaizima, the linked heavy cavalry with armour on man and beast, three riders to a team tied together by leather thongs, as well as the strong composite bows of the Jurchen horse archers, cheval-de-frise, battering poles, scaling ladders and stone-throwing engines; the linked cavalry was broken at Yancheng when infantry cut the legs of the horses.
tactics: 順昌之戰的戰術主軸是依城據險、以逸待勞，再以夜襲打亂敵營。宋軍不與金軍在城外曠野硬拼，先利用順昌四面河流、地勢平曠而城垣獨存的條件，把兵力收攏在城垣與附城營壘之間，分番進退，輪番休息以免被拖垮。迎敵手段包括三事：一是疑兵，於城上張設旗幟、排列疑似大軍的隊形，使兀朮誤判岳飛主力已全數抵達，因而不敢逕行攻城；二是斷水，遣將夜入金營，奪其馬匹並改動營旁水道，令金軍不能取水，士馬焦渴；三是火攻與夜襲，先破城南鹿角寨，再以精騎夜入金軍牙帳，焚其營柵器械，使金軍戒備與陣形同時混亂。破寨之後，岳飛乘勢逼城，金軍大潰，退兵之際宋軍緊追不舍。追擊到郾城時，宋軍改變戰法：重甲拐子馬恃皮索相連而難以散，步卒遂以麻扎刀專砍馬腿，使騎兵人馬俱倒，再由精騎蹂躪其陣，一舉瓦解。糧秣由襄陽沿汝水河運，岳家軍行軍不帶重輜，靠沿途徵發與補充維持，追擊過快也使戰役難以延長。
tacticsEn: The tactical core of Shunchang was to hold the city, rest on the defensive, and then use a night attack to disorder the enemy camp. The Song army did not meet the Jin in open ground outside the walls. It took advantage of the fact that Shunchang stood alone on a flat plain ringed by rivers, concentrating its strength between the city wall and a camp built against the wall, rotating units in and out of the line so the soldiers could rest rather than be worn down. Three measures were used to meet the great army. First, deception: banners were raised on the walls and formations suggestive of a main army were displayed, so that Wuzhu, believing Yue Fei's entire force had arrived, did not dare assault the city at once. Second, cutting off the water: men rode into the Jin camp by night, took horses and diverted the channel beside the camp, so the Jin troops could not draw water and men and horses went thirsty. Third, fire and night assault: the stockade on the south side of the city was taken first, then picked cavalry entered the Jin command tent by night and burned the palisades and engines, confusing the enemy guard and breaking their formations at the same time. With the stockades broken, Yue Fei pressed the attack to the walls, the Jin army collapsed, and the Song pursued them as they withdrew. At Yancheng the method changed: the tied armour cavalry could not scatter while men and horses were roped together, so infantry used the mazha sabre to cut at the horses' legs and bring riders and mounts down together, and the picked cavalry trampled the disordered ranks, breaking the formation in one stroke. Grain came by water from Xiangyang along the Ru River; the Yue Fei army marched without heavy baggage and lived off what it found along the way, and the speed of the pursuit also meant the campaign could not be prolonged.
data: 可考的數字有限，但骨架清楚。時間：順昌被圍與決戰在紹興十年即 1140 年正月至二月，城下大戰集中於二月，郾城追戰距順昌決戰僅約一日行程。兵力：史載兀朮遣大將王喜率眾十餘萬來寇，另有精騎萬餘直抵城下；岳飛所部為精騎八千，自鄂州兼程疾馳，一日百餘里。距離：順昌屬京西北路汝州，據汝水與穎水之間，四面平曠，河流環繞，距汝州百餘里，扼襄漢往來要道。戰果：夜襲破營奪馬千餘匹，並改其水道；郾城破拐子馬，斬首萬餘級，獲馬千餘匹。損失：金軍十餘萬眾在順昌城下一日之間潰散，兀朮僅以數千騎遁走，遺棄甲仗與馬匹甚多，但雙方總傷亡數字史無明載，不可以斬首之數反推全軍損失。兵器方面，順昌時宋軍已配火藥火箭與《武經總要》所錄猛火油器，然戰記通篇未見以希臘火或猛火油攻寨的記載。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked are few, but the frame is clear. Timing: the investment of Shunchang and the decisive fighting fall in the first and second months of the tenth year of Shaoxing, 1140; the battle beneath the walls was concentrated in the second month, and the pursuit to Yancheng was roughly a day's march from the field at Shunchang. Strength: the histories record that Wuzhu sent the general Wang Xi with more than a hundred thousand men, and that over ten thousand elite cavalry came right up to the walls; Yue Fei had eight thousand picked cavalry, taken out of Ezhou and marched at forced pace, more than a hundred li a day. Distance: Shunchang belonged to Ruzhou in the Jingxi circuit, sat between the Ru and Ying rivers, was flat on all sides and girdled by streams, lay a little over a hundred li from Ruzhou, and commanded the approaches between Xiangyang and the western capital. Results: the night attack broke the camp and took more than a thousand horses, and the watercourse was diverted; at Yancheng the tied cavalry was broken for a claimed thousand-plus heads and over a thousand horses taken. Losses: the Jin host of more than a hundred thousand broke up in a single day under the walls, and Wuzhu got away with only a few thousand riders, abandoning arms and horses; the total casualties on either side, however, are nowhere recorded, and no overall loss should be inferred by working backwards from the head count. Weapons: the Song already had gunpowder arrows and the menghuoyou apparatus of the Wujing Zongyao by the time of Shunchang, yet no account of the campaign records the use of Greek fire or fierce-fire oil against the camps.
cause: 順昌之戰的起因有遠有近。遠因是靖康之變以後宋金在河南、淮上拉鋸多年，金雖失去中原，卻在河南、汝、蔡一線保有重兵與據點，而順昌正處宋洛西軍與襄漢防線的門戶位置；金若拔順昌，即可自西北方向打通襄漢、威脅淮南，逼南宋重新議和。直接原因在紹興九年到十年：金熙宗完顏亶對已成的和議條件並不滿意，完顏宗弼乘南宋中樞主和派當權、邊軍反戰之際，集結十餘萬眾自河南南下，兵鋒直指順昌與汝州，順昌之戰實為其南攻計畫的前奏。宋方的動機同樣清楚：順昌是岳家軍駐地鄂州西面的門戶，朝廷命岳飛率兵往援；岳飛自紹興八年起屢請出師北伐、收復河南，順昌一旦失守，襄漢震動，此前的北伐主張便再無立足之地。於是順昌城下的碰撞，一半是金國要重開戰端的戰略選擇，一半是南宋邊軍要證明河南仍可爭取的戰役目標。
causeEn: The causes of the battle are both distant and immediate. In the distance, the Jingkang disaster had left Jin and Song contesting Henan and the Huai for years; although the Jin had lost the Central Plain, they still held heavy troops and positions around Henan, Ru and Cai, and Shunchang sat on the threshold of the Song western front and the Xiangyang line. If the Jin could take Shunchang they would open the road from the northwest into the Huai region, put pressure on the Southern Song from the rear and force the court to negotiate again. The immediate cause lay in the years 1139 to 1140: the Jin emperor Xizong was not satisfied with the terms already agreed, and Wuzhu, taking advantage of the peace party holding the central government while the frontier commanders argued for war, concentrated more than a hundred thousand men in Henan and drove them south, straight at Shunchang and Ruzhou; the battle was in effect the opening move of that southern offensive. The Song motive was equally plain. Shunchang was the gateway on the western side of Ezhou, where Yue Fei's army sat, and the court ordered him to relieve it. From the eighth year of Shaoxing Yue Fei had repeatedly petitioned to campaign north and recover Henan; if Shunchang fell, Xiangyang would be shaken and the case for the northern campaigns would lose all footing. The collision under the walls of Shunchang was therefore half a strategic choice by the Jin to reopen the war, and half an operational goal by the Song frontier to show that Henan could still be contested.
impact: 順昌之戰的影響，一在戰局，二在政局，三在這支部隊的命運。戰局上，金軍十餘萬眾在順昌城下崩潰，郾城再破拐子馬，南下的攻勢節奏被硬生生打斷，順昌與汝州一線穩住，襄漢方向暫時解除壓力，南宋在此後一年多裡得以再談和局。政局上，捷報傳到臨安，朝野為之振奮，主戰一派聲勢大漲；這場勝利本身成了日後和議中南宋仍能保有淮南、金方不得不把邊界劃在淮水一線的實力背景之一。對岳飛個人，順昌與郾城兩捷把他推到聲望頂點，軍中流行的說法是撼山容易、撼岳家軍難；也正因如此，他隨即被召回、兵權被削，紹興十年秋奉班師之詔南歸，紹興十一年除夕更被秦檜以謀反罪名殺害於臨安風波亭，岳家軍番號隨之取消，舊部被分併他軍，基於這場勝利建立起來的軍隊樣本在政治上反被拆散。長期看，此役說明南宋在野戰能力上並不缺，缺的正是可持續的補給線與能互相策應的諸路兵，這一課在後來采石與隆興年間的抗金作戰中反覆被提起。
impactEn: The effect of Shunchang worked on three levels: the battle, the politics, and the fate of the army that fought it. Militarily, a Jin host of more than a hundred thousand broke up under the walls, the tied armour cavalry was broken again at Yancheng, and the rhythm of the southern offensive was interrupted; Shunchang and the Ruzhou line held, the Xiangyang front was relieved of immediate pressure, and the Southern Song had room to talk again for more than a year afterwards. Politically, the news reached Lin'an and the court was stirred, and the war party rose; that victory was itself part of the military background behind the later settlement, in which the Song still held the territory south of the Huai and the Jin drew the frontier along the Huai. For Yue Fei personally, the two victories put him at the height of his renown, and the saying went round the army that mountains were easy to move but the Yue Fei army was hard; precisely because of that he was recalled, stripped of command, ordered south in the autumn of the tenth year of Shaoxing, and in fact killed on Qin Hui's charge of treason at the Fengbo Pavilion in Lin'an on the last day of the eleventh year of Shaoxing, after which the name of the Yue Fei army was abolished and its old units folded into others. The model army built on the strength of this victory was therefore dismantled politically. In the long run the campaign showed that the Southern Song was not short of field fighting ability; what it lacked was a sustainable line of supply and a set of mutually supporting armies, and the lesson was raised again and again in the later resistance at Caishi and in the Longxing years.
result: 結果是南宋完勝。順昌城保住，城下十餘萬金軍在夜襲與破寨之後大潰，兀朮乘驛馬突圍，僅率數千騎退回，沿途遺棄甲仗、旗鼓與大量馬匹。岳飛乘勝追擊，先在郾城破金人重甲拐子馬，斬首萬餘級、獲馬千餘匹，進抵蔡州一線，兀朮宵遁歸汴京，金人南下的氣焰為之一挫。戰術上這是一場以守城為依托、以夜襲和機動取勝的典型戰役：宋軍兵力遠少而勝，靠的是據城、疑兵、斷水、破寨的連續動作，以及弓弩對重甲的針對性打法，金軍人多勢眾反而被自己的營寨與水源拖累。戰果卻沒有延伸成戰略勝利：南宋援軍未集，糧秣靠河運，追擊又急，岳軍在蔡州不敢久屯；同年七月朝廷詔令各軍退守所部，岳飛班師回鄂州，兵權被削。順昌與郾城的兩場勝利終究沒有換回河南，紹興十一年和議仍以淮水至大散關分界，宋向金稱臣，歲輸銀絹各二十五萬。順昌城後來數度易手歸入金朝，而這場以弱勝強的戰役，成了南宋抗金史上最常被引用的名篇之一。
resultEn: The result was a complete Song victory. Shunchang held, and the Jin army of more than a hundred thousand collapsed after the night attack and the storming of the stockades; Wuzhu broke out on a post horse with a few thousand riders and withdrew, abandoning arms, drums and many horses on the way. Yue Fei pursued, broke the Jin tied armour cavalry at Yancheng with a claimed thousand-plus heads taken and over a thousand horses captured, and pushed on to the Cai prefecture line, where Wuzhu slipped away by night back to Bianjing and the momentum of the southern raid was broken. Tactically this was a typical battle won on the defensive, by night attack and mobility: the Song army was far outnumbered yet prevailed because of the sequence of holding the city, feigning strength, cutting the water and storming the stockades, and because bows were used against armour in a targeted way, while the Jin host was slowed by its own camps and its own water supply. The victory, however, did not grow into a strategic one. Song reinforcements had not converged, grain came by water, and the pursuit was hurried, so the Yue Fei army could not stay long at Cai; in the seventh month of the year the court ordered the armies back to their own circuits, and Yue Fei returned to Ezhou with his command curtailed. Neither Shunchang nor Yancheng brought back Henan, and the settlement of the eleventh year of Shaoxing still left the frontier on the line from the Huai to Dasan Pass, with the Song acknowledging vassalage and paying tribute of 250,000 taels of silver and 250,000 bolts of silk each year. Shunchang changed hands repeatedly and passed into the hands of the Jin, yet this battle of a weaker force defeating a stronger one remains one of the most frequently cited engagements in Song-Jin history.
